title: SkyBlock Menu and Fast Travel
summary: The SkyBlock Menu opens everything from one board, as on Hypixel. Fast Travel warps you to your island, the Hub, and each island once you've visited it.

s.x: Press the menu key (
K
unless you changed it in Controls) and the menu opens on the
SkyBlock Menu
On the left is
you
: your character (it looks at your mouse), your name, the profile you're playing, where you are, the SkyBlock date and time, and your purse.
On the right is everything you can open, in four colour-coded groups. Each tile shows something live about it:

rows.x: Your Profile, Skills, Collections, SkyBlock Leveling
(how many items in how many pages),
(your accessories, Magical Power), Pets (your pet out),

s.x: The grey Personal Bank tile is still being built (the Banker in the Hub runs the bank for now). Every page is also in the menu's sidebar on the left.
Choose
Fast Travel
in the SkyBlock Menu, or type
/warp <place>
. Each warp has a short warm-up: stand still, and you can't warp while you're in combat.
More islands get a warp as they're built. Like on Hypixel, you have to
visit an island once
before you can warp to it. The first time you arrive, chat says
Fast Travel unlocked
, and the warp lights up on the Fast Travel page.
Public islands are protected, so you can't break or build on them. The exception is the parts meant to be worked: a farm's crops, a forest's trees, a mine's ore.
In those areas you can break the blocks that belong there. They
grow back
after a few seconds. Mined ore turns to bedrock until it does.
Monsters keep spawning in fighting areas (like a graveyard), and only there can you fight on a public island.
